data.description:
## Context
Gerrit 1876 patch set 2, GitHub Actions run 32193981982, Ubuntu Python 3.11 job 95894688032 failed after 13,892 tests passed. The session teardown fixture `tests/conftest.py::_remove_readonly_run_snapshots` evaluated `tuple(tmp_path.rglob(".rebar/run_snapshots"))`; traversal entered `repo/.tickets-tracker/.ticket-write.lock.d`, which disappeared during recursion, and `pathlib` raised `FileNotFoundError`. The failing node was `tests/interfaces/store/test_workflow_entrypoints.py::test_mcp_run_workflow_is_async_and_pollable`.

## Plan
- Reproduce the traversal failure with a deterministic barrier while separating three rivals: Python/pathlib version semantics, concurrent mkdir-lock churn, and fixture scope over the whole pytest temp tree.
- Establish defect legitimacy and caller impact from the teardown contract and prior read-only snapshot cleanup bug.
- Design a held-out race oracle at the smallest tier that executes the production teardown helper with real concurrent filesystem mutation; prove final-form RED.
- Repair only the confirmed mechanism, then prove held-out GREEN, exact-defect mutation RED, and original-scenario replication.
- Sweep all live recursive teardown scans for the same disappearing-entry hazard and disposition any siblings.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A runtime experiment deterministically proves the root cause and rejects pathlib-version-only and unrelated-fixture explanations.
- [ ] A gating regression test uses a deterministic synchronization barrier, reaches the disappearing-directory state, and asserts cleanup completes without masking unrelated filesystem errors.
- [ ] The final-form oracle is observed RED before repair, GREEN after a held-out repair, and RED again under an exact-defect mutation.
- [ ] Focused fixture/workflow tests, the broad relevant test gate, lint, and typecheck pass.
- [ ] All live recursive teardown scans are audited and every confirmed sibling is fixed or ticketed.
- [ ] The CI scenario no longer reproduces under repeated synchronized churn.
data.title: Snapshot teardown rglob races disappearing tracker lock directory
